objective.text: Combine when and skip conditions without assuming registration order overrides their meaning.

difficulty.rationale: Apply both eligibility and veto conditions rather than letting the last registration win.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.scope: Inside schedule registration; $schedule is a Schedule instance.

stem: The event is due and its environment permits running. With the shown values, do its filters permit execution?

options.text: Yes; the two true values cancel each other.
options.rationale: The scheduler does not combine these conditions with exclusive-or arithmetic.
options.misconception: The scheduler does not combine these conditions with exclusive-or arithmetic.

options.text: Yes; a true when result overrides every skip predicate.
options.rationale: A positive condition does not disable the independent rejection condition.
options.misconception: A positive condition does not disable the independent rejection condition.

options.text: No; when passes but skip supplies a veto.
options.rationale: All positive filters must pass and no skip predicate may reject the event.

options.text: It depends only on whether skip was registered last.
options.rationale: The filters and rejects have defined roles rather than a last-call-wins boolean setting.
options.misconception: The filters and rejects have defined roles rather than a last-call-wins boolean setting.
